generic_lessons: A negative eligibility sample across obsolete unit types does not prove the entire training feature is broken. Scan actual contemporary types with the same native gates used at dispatch.
Check the meaning of each audit counter. A syntactically valid observer that increments noncivilian for recognized civilians reverses its claim.
Lua method references lose their receiver when passed without self. A protected call can hide the error behind nil data; retain explicit failure and qualify receiver forwarding.
SourceBACKGROUND is request provenance, not a field of the vanilla completion event. Correlate distinct sources rather than inventing event metadata.
Resource stock combines debits and income. A native quote plus a compatible balance equation supports a narrow account, not all affordability or resource-insufficient branches.
Independent inventory is not an atomic internal budget snapshot. Pending/submitted commitments and completed idle-head adjustments remain explicit limits.
Ordinary TEST_PLAYER military moves and votes are allowed QA inputs; they must remain separate from BACKGROUND orders and cannot supply missing civilian automation.
A false readiness gate during diplomacy or queued execution is a stop for dependent calls, not a product failure or turn transition. Preserve unique failed attempts and actual state.
